title: EMS Solar PV Inverter Communication Configuration
description: Modbus connection and inverter parameters for the Solar PV inverter. Supports both Modbus RTU (RS485) and Modbus TCP. Monitors solar generation power, MPPT trackers, and inverter status.

_schema_version.description: Schema version for migration detection. Must match the schema expected version.

connection.description: Modbus transport layer configuration. Protocol selects RTU (RS485 serial) or TCP (Ethernet).

protocol.description: Modbus transport protocol. 'rtu' uses RS485 serial, 'tcp' uses Ethernet.

slave_id.description: Modbus slave/unit ID of the PV inverter device.

device.description: Serial device path for Modbus RTU. Example: /dev/ttyUSB3 or /dev/ttyS4.

baud_rate.description: Serial baud rate for Modbus RTU. Must match inverter hardware configuration. Default: 9600.

parity.description: Serial parity for Modbus RTU. N=None, E=Even, O=Odd. Default: N.

stopbits.description: Number of serial stop bits for Modbus RTU. Default: 1.

host.description: IP address or hostname of the PV inverter for Modbus TCP.

port.description: TCP port number for Modbus TCP. Standard Modbus TCP port is 502.

inverter.description: PV inverter hardware parameters. Defines rated generation capacity and number of MPPT input channels.

rated_power_kw.description: Nominal rated AC output power of the PV inverter. Used by control_manager for solar forecast and dispatch planning.

mppt_count.description: Number of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) input channels on the inverter. Each MPPT tracker connects to a separate string of PV panels.

timing.description: Modbus polling interval and timeout configuration for PV inverter communication.

poll_interval_ms.description: How often to poll inverter registers for power and energy generation readings.

timeout_ms.description: Modbus request timeout. If no response within this window, the request is retried or a fault is raised.
